data.name: Total Vengeance
data.detailed_description:
"Total Vengeance" throws you into a relentless survival horror experience where every step could be your last. Stranded after a botched heist, you’ll battle bloodthirsty wolves, grotesque monsters, and the creeping dread of the unknown. Scavenge for supplies, solve deadly puzzles, and fight to reunite with your partner all while uncovering the dark secrets lurking in the shadows.

Key Features:

  • Survival Horror at its Core – Face relentless threats where every bullet and breath counts.

  • Exploration & Resource Management – Scavenge supplies, manage inventory, and make life-or-death decisions.

  • Terrifying Enemies – From savage wolves to nightmarish monsters, danger stalks every step.

  • Atmospheric Environments – Explore eerie forests, dark interiors, and tense open spaces.

data.short_description: After a heist gone wrong, you’re stranded in a deserted part of town with a strange secret. Survive the hunt, expose the truth, and outrun the darkness.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

content_descriptors.notes:
Mature Content:

The game includes depictions of violence, as it is set in a dark and dangerous environment where the player will encounter hostile creatures and engage in combat.
There are scenes that depict intense and suspenseful situations, adding to the overall atmosphere of fear and tension.
The storyline delves into themes of revenge and personal struggle, which may involve morally complex choices and emotional intensity.
Sensitive Topics:

We acknowledge that sexual assault and non-consensual sex are deeply sensitive and disturbing subjects. We want to assure potential players that such content is not present in "Total Vengeance." We understand the gravity of these topics and have intentionally chosen not to include them in the game.
Drug and alcohol abuse are not central themes in the game; however, they may be referenced in the environment or in the context of character backgrounds.
Self-harm is not depicted in the game.
